experiments.scope: Organizer-executed reconstruction of one committed SHA-256/32 witness from the embedded tuple record, exact lookup-table slices, and tail record. The program repeats the same deterministic derivation for every organizer trial, while the organizer independently checks the full-collision event.
experiments.hypothesis: The committed embedded slices deterministically derive two distinct 128-byte messages with equal complete-message sha256-r32-prefix-v1 digests matching the committed expected digest. This experiment tests one-record witness derivation only and makes no inference about attack cost, search success probability, lookup-table completeness, or resource use.
